svg.title: At eye level
svg.desc: Ridinger's landscape sits to the left of a separate photograph of a limestone monk's head. The central stag's raised head and the monk's lowered eyes are placed at nearly the same height. No connecting lines or viewer marker are drawn.
svg.text: Johann Elias Ridinger · early to mid-18th century
The Metropolitan Museum of Art · public-domain collection images · objects 1974.110 and 42.25.10
No drawn connection. The arrangement is mine.
